summary: Tested public compliance API and core desktop UI. API critical flows passed; UI dashboard, search, status update, and initial navigation worked, but add-client submission did not complete in browser.

ui_bugs.issue: After filling required fields and clicking Create workspace, modal remains open and active client does not change in browser E2E flow, despite POST /api/clients passing independently.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend submit flow did not resolve/close modal during browser test; investigate browser network/console response handling.

action_items: Fix and retest Add client modal POST/close/active workspace flow.

Implement or expose missing requested reminders/escalations, audit history UI, reports/exports beyond basic CSV, evidence association to obligations, and People/auditors view; current People navigation renders the dashboard fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has no axios error handlers for clients, obligations, status updates, add-client, or upload, so failures are silent except modal staying open.
Filter button and search icon are non-functional controls.
Calendar mutates items in render via items.sort(...), which can mutate React state ordering.
Backend obligation seeding uses find-then-insert without concurrency protection; simultaneous first requests can duplicate seed rows.

success_rate.frontend: approximately 60% (dashboard/search/status/switch navigation passed; add-client flow failed; later flows blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Review Client via API and Browser Review Client submission was attempted; test data may remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL is https://boring-to-brilliant-1.preview.emergentagent.com. API regression passed clients, obligations, PATCH persistence, client POST, and multipart evidence POST. Browser run loaded dashboard and verified search/status/client switcher, then add-client modal submission stalled.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: load app, click Add client, fill client-name-input and client-code-input, click save-client-button. Modal remains visible and active-client-name is unchanged. Independent requests POST succeeds, so likely frontend request rejection/response handling or browser integration issue; inspect network response and addClient catch/error state.
